entry.name: rnbo_beatstoms~
entry.digest: Convert beat time (quarter notes) to milliseconds.
entry.description: Use the beatstoms~ object to convert an incoming number or signal from beats values to milliseconds using the tempo of the device transport.

arguments.name: beattime
arguments.description: The number of beats (quarter notes) to be converted to the equivalent time in milliseconds using the tempo of the device transport.
